Note: Base Application page 9170 "Profile Card" validates its Role Center ID in OnInsertRecord, via ValidateRoleCenterIdExists -> AllObjWithCaption.TestField("Object Subtype", 'RoleCenter') for page 9022. The runner leaves "Object Subtype" at BC's default (empty) on every AllObj / AllObjWithCaption row, so that TestField raises "Object Subtype must be equal to 'RoleCenter' ... Current value is ''". Tracked as #2326, which stays open after this entry lands. This surfaced only once #2729 made precompiled pages' lifecycle triggers run at all: before that, page 9170's OnInsertRecord resolved to NavForm's empty base virtual, returned true, and the insert proceeded without ever validating anything -- so the test passed by not executing the check it is about. The entry records a gap that was always there, not a new one; removing it is part of fixing #2326.

Corpus PR #264 (commit 29042fc) pins what AllObjWithCaption answers in "Object Subtype" per object kind -- 'Card'/'List' for a page's PageType, the codeunit's Subtype, the table's TableType. The runner leaves the field at BC's default (empty) on every AllObj / AllObjWithCaption row, which is #2326, the same gap the entry above already records. Measured on this branch's pin (920a7bed) with BOTH the runner at main (the packed 2.10.0-local.5ad50bc2 tool, a main commit predating this branch; PR #3391 unmerged) and this branch's build: the identical four methods fail either way, so the failure arrives with the corpus commit and is not caused by the Permission Set change here. The maintainer's open PR #3391 fixes #2326; these entries are deleted when it lands. The other two methods #264 adds -- _Get_InstallCodeunit_ObjectSubtypeIsEmpty and _Get_Report_ObjectSubtypeIsEmpty -- assert an EMPTY subtype and therefore pass already, so they get no entry.
